title: Does Trading Spur Specialization? Evidence from Patenting
eligible_reason: Binary staggered treatment exists (patent exchange established in the firm's province; first-treatment years 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009 across 26 provinces, 5 never treated), but Treat never enters alone in a linear TWFE: Tables 1-3 and 5-7 pair it with continuous interactions (Treat x net patents sold / licensed out / R&D efficiency) and estimate patent counts by Poisson (ppmlhdfe); Table 4 has Treat alone but with time-varying patent-, assignee- and province-level controls and an extra technology-class FE.
design_notes: From Master.do and ReadMe.txt. Firm-level files: unit firm_ID, FE firm_ID + ind_year_group (industry x year); Treat = 1 if a patent exchange exists in the firm's province by that year; key regressors are Treat_NetNumSold (Treat x net # patents sold), Treat_NetNumLicensedOut, Treat_RnDEfficiency, and triple interactions with HighLiquid / Constrained; Innovation_Output (count) via ppmlhdfe, CARs_of_New_Product via reghdfe; controls Assets RnD Capex ROA Leverage in even columns; cluster province_ID. Table 5 (Dynamic_DiD.dta): relative-time dummies Treat_Lag_4_Plus..Treat_Fwd_4_Plus and their interactions with NetNumSold. Table 4 (Innovation_Scope.dta, 1.9m patents 2001-2019): reghdfe Distance_Iota_2_3 Treat Patent_Stock Patent_Experience Citations_Received Population GDP RnD Fiscal_Revenue, a(assignee_ID tech_class year). Cohorts from Innovation_Scope.dta: 13 provinces first treated 2006, 3 in 2007, 8 in 2008, 2 in 2009; 5 of 31 provinces never treated.
estimators_reported: Poisson pseudo-ML with firm and industry-year FE (ppmlhdfe)
TWFE (reghdfe) with Treat x continuous interactions
TWFE with Treat and time-varying controls (Table 4)
dynamic DiD with relative-time dummies x continuous interaction (Table 5)

ineligible_specs.reason: Poisson (ppmlhdfe); continuous Treat x X interactions
linear, but Treat x continuous interaction as additional treatment regressor; even columns add time-varying firm controls
Treat alone but time-varying controls (Patent_Stock, Patent_Experience, Citations_Received, Population, GDP, RnD, Fiscal_Revenue) and extra tech_class FE
relative-time dummies interacted with continuous NetNumSold; Poisson for counts

package_files.note: Analysis files shipped by authors; sources are CNIPA (public) and CSMAR (licensed via WRDS). Firm-level files carry ind_year_group but no plain year variable.

screener_notes: Near-miss: Table 4 column with Treat alone would be eligible without its time-varying controls; Table 1 CARs column (1) would be eligible without Treat_NetNumSold. Neither is reported as such. Flags cite_baker_larcker_wang_2022 / cite_cengiz_et_al_2019 suggest the text discusses stacked DiD; no such code in the kit.
